summary: iter-85 independent verification of the new adaptive daily risk budget (risk_budget.py) + 3 new sizing multipliers (spread/regime/exposure) + hot-path regression (bot_runner + execution). Backend: 17/17 pytest green — 9/9 pre-existing tests/test_iter85_sizing_budget.py (multiplier math, scope classification, exhaustion/shrink/perf-shrink) + 8 NEW tests in tests/test_iter85_budget_http.py (auth gating, response shape, admin default, non-admin cross-tenant 403, bogus id 404, perf-shrink observable, bot/status 200, trades list 200, risk/layers 200). Live-verified GET /api/risk/budget returns pool_risk_pct=3.0 + 5 strategies with allocations summing to 100 and every required key (allocation_pct, perf_weight, budget_risk_pct, spent_risk_pct, remaining_risk_pct). Admin trend perf_weight=0.66 confirmed (real losing history). No exceptions in backend logs from bot_runner budget gate or adaptive_sizing (grepped for 'risk budget check failed', 'traceback', 'bot_runner' — none). Frontend: admin session → /commander renders BOTH Protection Layers card (10/12 ARMED · 2 DEGRADED — news + weekly-loss, expected) AND the new Daily Risk Budget card (data-testid risk-budget-card + risk-budget-pool badge 'POOL 3% / DAY · RESETS 00:00 UTC' + all 5 rows risk-budget-{trend|scalp|breakout|mean_reversion|experimental} with progress bars). TREND row shows the ×0.66 PERF shrink tag (admin has losing history). Regression pages (/bot-health, /trades, /dashboard) load fine. Test users cleaned up post-run.
critical_code_review_comments: risk_budget.py — DEFAULT_ALLOCATIONS keys (trend/scalp/breakout/mean_reversion/experimental) sum to exactly 1.0 (verified). budget_status returns strategies in a deterministic order and always includes every key required by the UI. Shape is stable — safe for the UI card to iterate directly.

risk_budget.check_budget — 3-way outcome (blocked | shrunk | allowed) is verified by the 9-case pytest. Fail-open policy is correct: bot_runner's try/except wrapper logs a warning and lets the pulse through if the check errors — consistent with the review-request note 'never disable'.

adaptive_sizing.py — spread_mult / regime_mult / exposure_mult are pure functions with no I/O; unit-tested boundaries: FX spread tiers (1→0.85→0.7→0.55), XAU exempt (3.0 pips still 1.0), regime scaling (TREND 1.1 / RANGE 0.9 / SHOCK 0.7 / None 1.0), exposure floor and floating-loss compounding. Composition inside compute_adaptive_risk multiplies these — because every factor is bounded ∈ [0.5, 1.1], the compounded risk_pct stays bounded (no unbounded amplification).

routes/risk_layers_routes.py:39-58 (GET /risk/budget) — ownership check identical to /risk/layers (admin bypass via role, 404 on unknown ObjectId, 403 on cross-tenant), and cfg lookup falls back to the user's global bot_config when account_id absent. Clean, no MongoDB ObjectId leakage in the response.

bot_runner.py budget gate (lines ~1518-1544) — SKIP-pulse on exhausted, shrink otherwise, fail-open on exception. No backend log evidence of the gate misfiring during the ~20 min preview window observed. Note: scalp-side enforcement is intentionally deferred per review-request; consumption still tracked via strategy_class on trade docs.

execution.py (~L246/330) — trade_doc now carries strategy_class + risk_pct. No insert errors in logs; existing GET /api/trades continues to serialize fine (verified via HTTP test). Older trade docs lacking these fields don't break budget_status (the aggregation uses $ifNull-style defaults).

RiskBudgetCard.jsx — polls every 60s (vs 30s for RiskLayersCard), on any error setHidden(true) hides the card until re-mount (same silent-failure pattern as RiskLayersCard). Progress-bar color transitions correctly at 75%/100% and never overflows past 100% (Math.min guard). Font stack + colors consistent with the surrounding STOIC UI.
